content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed the terms and would like to request a couple of adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on contract termination, only the client has the right to terminate without cause, while you do not have an equivalent right; I propose modifying it so that either party may terminate this agreement by giving thirty days written notice to the other party. - Regarding the relevant clause on the first instalment, your payment is conditional on an event controlled entirely by the client, which puts your compensation at risk; I propose updating it so that the first instalment shall be paid on the Effective Date. Thank you, and I look forward to working together.
